intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A young messenger is whispering urgently to an attendant. By the third listener, the story has grown two extra horns.

intro.speaker: MESSENGER
intro.text: “A monster near the royal paths! Great armored back! Enormous claws! An impossible stare! And the princess was *nearby*!”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I have the usual number of horns. Please keep that part accurate.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A small, moss-backed creature trundles out from behind a step. A fallen blossom sits on its head like a crown.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: It is unarmed. It appears to be looking for shade.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “It once stole a judge’s lunch and left the plate very clean.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The creature wanders toward a busy walkway. Kaedra asks people to give it room, then points it down the shaded route home. Nobody draws a weapon.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “There was a rumor. Several people believed it enough to run. One of them ran into a door.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “The story was foolish. The door was very real. I take that part seriously.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Down the shaded path, the creature trundles out of sight. Kaedra notices you are still standing beside her.

options.labelText: “You calmed everyone down and got the little one home. I wish that was the story, instead of two monsters.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “That is more or less what I was trying to do.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Their concerns have been entered into the record.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She smiles, and forgets to check who is watching.

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I cannot control every story about me. I can control what I do in them.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Somewhere down the shaded path, a sandwich is left unattended for the last time.

options.labelText: “It’s a ridiculous rumor. Ignore it and it’ll blow over.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “It may. The bruise from the door will take longer.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I was trying to make it sound less serious.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Please take me seriously. Just without turning me into a tragedy.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She goes to help the messenger straighten out the story. She does not ask you to come.

options.labelText: “Why reassure anyone? You’re frightening. So is that thing. Let them be scared.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Fear is not a service I provide.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I didn’t think you’d take it personally.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Then you have not been paying attention.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She walks the creature the rest of the way into the shade and does not come back.
